change_scope: Documentation only: environment-neutral startup wrappers, separate handoff and relay wrappers, shared tool selection and GitHub record reference.
rules_reviewed_against_actual_skills_and: startup performs first initialization only and never automatically consumes a handoff.
handoff saves a fixed checkpoint and requests stop; it does not create a successor.
relay consumes an existing handoff for the same identity and loads the exact checkpoint.
Formal AW tools are preferred when available on either local or cloud sessions; permission denial does not authorize a GitHub bypass.
The selected GitHub manual extension requires conditional updates and explicit current-user confirmation of manual stop; Desktop/CLI release still requires real adapter observation.
limitations: The seven compatibility checks use a retained temporary local Git fixture, not the daily aw-team workspace.
The prompts have not been executed by new real local/cloud sessions; no real user confirmation, native identity, idle observation, automatic delivery, or real chat handoff was verified.
Existing agent.bind still rejects a missing native session ID. The manual session=null trial is not formal command support.
No daily instance, Binding, message, checkpoint, installation, permission, or automation was changed by preparing these materials.
No application source, runtime recovery behavior, or installed Skill was changed; the two runtime defects remain pending repair and real verification.
